name: discord-mcp
description: Safe, configurable Discord access through the Model Context Protocol
long_description: Read Discord servers, channels, and messages through a local MCP server. Message writes and deletes remain disabled unless the user explicitly enables them, and allowlists can restrict access to selected guilds and channels.

discord_token.title: Discord Bot Token
discord_token.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Never use a user token.

allowed_guild_ids.title: Allowed Discord server IDs
allowed_guild_ids.description: Optional comma-separated guild IDs. Leave empty to allow every guild visible to the bot.

allowed_channel_ids.title: Allowed Discord channel IDs
allowed_channel_ids.description: Optional comma-separated channel IDs. Leave empty to allow every channel in an allowed guild.

enable_writes.title: Enable message writes
enable_writes.description: Expose tools that send messages and edit messages created by this bot.

enable_deletes.title: Enable message deletes
enable_deletes.description: Expose the delete tool. Writes must also be enabled, and each delete still requires confirmation.

allow_unrestricted_writes.title: Allow writes without an allowlist
allow_unrestricted_writes.description: Permit writes when both guild and channel allowlists are empty. Keep disabled for normal use.

max_response_chars.title: Maximum response characters
max_response_chars.description: Maximum serialized size of a tool or resource response.
